article.story: HUNTINGTON, W.Va. -- — Fazl Oshodi’s 20 points helped Marshall defeat East Tennessee State 67-55 on Tuesday. Oshodi added five rebounds for the Thundering Herd (2-3). Bryce Slay scored 12 points, going 3 of 9 and 6 of 6 from the free-throw line. Noah Otshudi went 4 of 9 from the field to finish with 10 points, while adding seven assists and three steals. Kendall Campbell finished with 13 points for the Buccaneers (1-3). East Tennessee State also got 10 points, five assists and two steals from B.J. Ward. Tyran Mason finished with nine points, 11 rebounds and four steals. Up next Up next for Marshall is a matchup Friday with North Carolina on the road. East Tennessee State hosts Longwood on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
